must_satisfy.statement: The production planning tool must create a reviewable proposal without adopting it.

must_not.statement: The scripted engineering fixture must not be presented as a formal model evaluation.

acceptable_variations: The user-visible wording may vary while the persisted proposal remains reviewable.
critical_failures: Skipping the production Agent Runtime or plan proposal tool.
adjudication_note: Engineering-chain oracle only; it is never model-visible.
